cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 4.2.3.0)
set(CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "/mnt/c/Users/User/Desktop/WynlandOs/qtbase/cmake;/mnt/c/Users/User/Desktop/WynlandOs/qtbase/cmake/3rdparty/extra-cmake-modules/find-modules;/mnt/c/Users/User/Desktop/WynlandOs/qtbase/cmake/3rdparty/kwin;/mnt/c/Users/User/Desktop/WynlandOs/qtbase/cmake/platforms")
cmake_policy(SET CMP0128 OLD)
project(CMAKE_TRY_COMPILE CXX)
set(CMAKE_VERBOSE_MAKEFILE 1)
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "-I/mnt/c/Users/User/Desktop/WynlandOs/include -D__wynland__ -I/mnt/c/Users/User/Desktop/WynlandOs/include -D__wynland__ ")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} ${COMPILE_DEFINITIONS}")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG "-g")
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "")
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "${CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS} ${EXE_LINKER_FLAGS}")
include_directories(${INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES})
set(CMAKE_SUPPRESS_REGENERATION 1)
link_directories(${LINK_DIRECTORIES})
add_definitions([==[-DHAVE_getifaddrs]==])
cmake_policy(SET CMP0083 NEW)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0155 OLD)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0157 OLD)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0181 OLD)
include("${CMAKE_ROOT}/Modules/Internal/HeaderpadWorkaround.cmake")
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "/mnt/c/Users/User/Desktop/WynlandOs/build_qt/CMakeFiles/CMakeScratch/TryCompile-GPlZUD")
add_executable(cmTC_c50bc)
target_sources(cmTC_c50bc PRIVATE
  "/mnt/c/Users/User/Desktop/WynlandOs/build_qt/CMakeFiles/CMakeScratch/TryCompile-GPlZUD/src.cxx"
)
file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/cmTC_c50bc_loc"
     CONTENT $<TARGET_FILE:cmTC_c50bc>)
set_property(TARGET cmTC_c50bc PROPERTY "CXX_STANDARD" "17")
set_property(TARGET cmTC_c50bc PROPERTY "CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED" "ON")
target_link_libraries(cmTC_c50bc ${LINK_LIBRARIES})
